symptom: DLT publication cannot be selected dynamically from message headers and exception after retries
diagnostic: Separate retry eligibility from terminal DLT routing; record the retry-topic configuration and header predicate requirement.

symptom: Exception-based custom DLT routing fails at listener initialization with a reusable retry-topic ordering error
diagnostic: Capture Spring Kafka version and destination-topic chain before changing DLT configuration; fixed for the 4.0.0 RC line.

symptom: Backoff disrupts batch-listener recovery when records span multiple partitions
diagnostic: Preserve partition, failed index, seeks, backoff, assignment, and committed offsets; do not generalize record-listener recovery semantics to batch listeners.

symptom: BatchListenerFailedException can commit offsets preceding the declared failed index even when application processing was not complete
diagnostic: Verify the application honors the failed-index contract; compare side effects with committed offsets and treat preceding records as successfully processed by contract.

symptom: A failing Kotlin suspend listener is redelivered without bound after DefaultErrorHandler retries are exhausted
diagnostic: Capture listener return model, transactional mode, backoff, recovery outcome, offsets, and exact framework version; the report affected the 4.1 prerelease line.

symptom: RabbitMQ 4.3 quorum-queue delivery-count semantics change breaks retry and dead-letter expectations
diagnostic: Record broker and Spring AMQP versions, queue type, delivery-limit policy, x-delivery-count and x-acquired-count; distinguish broker semantics from container retry.

symptom: Jackson message conversion can miss the byte-array path for binary formats when content-type contains an encoding parameter
diagnostic: Capture raw content-type, content-encoding, converter class, target type and body representation; do not assume JSON text conversion.

symptom: A concurrency race affects AMQP 1.0 listener consumer batches
diagnostic: Capture container type, concurrency, batch size, credit, acknowledgements and duplicate or missing delivery evidence; this issue is a backport of 3529.

symptom: RepublishMessageRecoverer includes an error stack trace by default, which can enlarge dead-letter headers beyond broker frame constraints
diagnostic: Inspect recoverer settings, frame_max, exception-header size and returned-message evidence; prefer bounded diagnostic headers.

symptom: A reported long-running publisher degradation produced unroutable returns and missing callbacks
diagnostic: The project marked this report invalid; first isolate Spring Cloud Stream binding lifecycle, exchange and routing-key state, confirms, returns and broker topology before blaming Spring AMQP.

symptom: An SFTP closeable-resource header reaches Kafka header mapping and cannot be serialized
diagnostic: Trace message headers across the StreamTransformer boundary; remove lifecycle-only resource headers after closure instead of relaxing global serialization.

symptom: Trace ID changes when ErrorChannel is a PublishSubscribeChannel
diagnostic: Compare observation context at the failing endpoint, ErrorMessage creation and each error-channel subscriber; distinguish trace propagation from message delivery.

symptom: A named output channel on an inbound JMS Java DSL component fails startup because BeanFactory is unavailable
diagnostic: Capture Integration version, adapter or gateway type, DSL overload and whether a channel instance or channel name is supplied; fixed and backported.

symptom: ReactiveStreamsConsumer over a PollableChannel can drain and lose a message during stop
diagnostic: Correlate stop and subscription-disposal timing with receive calls, channel depth and downstream acknowledgements; preserve shutdown race evidence.

symptom: JdbcMetadataStore putIfAbsent can remain in a loop on MySQL
diagnostic: Capture database, isolation, lock waits, duplicate-key outcomes and caller retry; this issue is a backport of 10847 and is not a general poller failure.

symptom: ExecutionContext advances after a failed chunk, so restart can skip rolled-back items
diagnostic: Compare business transaction rollback, ItemStream update, repository context and restart offset; verify the exact Batch 6 patch level.

symptom: AbstractPaginatedDataItemReader jumpToItem restores the wrong position and can skip items on restart
diagnostic: Record page size, saved item count, page number, first post-restart item and ordering stability; fixed in 6.0.2 and backported.

symptom: SQL Server metadata VARCHAR columns conflict with Unicode JDBC parameters, causing implicit conversion, degraded plans and possible deadlocks
diagnostic: Inspect shipped DDL version, actual column types, JDBC parameter types, plans and lock graph before changing metadata columns.

symptom: The Spring Batch 6 SQL Server migration script fails against metadata created by 5.2.4
diagnostic: Record source and target Batch versions, database engine, original DDL provenance and exact failed statement; never rerun a partially applied migration blindly.

symptom: Concurrent restart may lack the serialization protection used when a JobInstance is first created
diagnostic: Treat this as an open investigation; collect launchers, job instance and execution IDs, isolation, unique constraints, timestamps and repository rows.
